summary: Verified Navbar brand text fix. On both desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844), the [data-testid='nav-logo'] renders 'Pizzeria Rainone' with computed color rgb(214, 219, 225) (#d6dbe1) and a sub-label 'Baronissi' in rgba(214, 219, 225, 0.7). Text is present in DOM and visually visible after the intro-loader lifts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navbar brand text 'Pizzeria Rainone' verified in silver #d6dbe1. Note that querying the outer wrapper span computes to white (inherited from parent button) — always target the inner span with class 'font-serif-display' to assert the color.
rca of the issue: Original bug: 'Pizzeria Rainone' text missing from navbar. Fix: added a flex-col span with inner 'Pizzeria Rainone' (text-[#d6dbe1]) and 'Baronissi' sub-label next to logo image in Navbar.jsx. Verified rendered text and computed color match spec.
